faqs.q: What is a 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve used for?
faqs.a: A 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve (10K, sour service) is a three-handle double block and bleed valve that gives positive isolation plus a bleed for instrument tap-offs. Positive isolation + bleed for instrumentation tap-offs.

faqs.q: What does NPT female mean on the 1/2 in 10,000 psi valve ends?
faqs.a: The listing gives 1/2 in NPT Female (process) on the inlet and 1/2 in NPT Female (instrument) on the outlet; NPT is the tapered pipe thread and female means the thread is cut inside the valve body. Seal with thread sealant and confirm the thread rating with the mating fitting.

faqs.q: What end connections does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve have?
faqs.a: On the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve (sour service) the inlet is 1/2 in NPT Female (process) and the outlet is 1/2 in NPT Female (instrument). NPT ends make up with thread sealant such as PTFE tape or anaerobic sealant, and the threaded joint, not the valve, may limit the pressure of the assembly.

faqs.q: Should I choose the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve or the 1/2 in 10,000 psi version?
faqs.a: Choose by line size, pressure and service. This listing is 1/2 in at 10,000 psi (sour service); the [Gauge Isolation Valve](/p/gauge-isolation-valve-single-block-1-2-in-npt-1-2-in-npt-10-000-psi-standard-service) is rated 10,000 psi with 1/2 in NPT Female (process) on the inlet. Match pressure class and end connection of the mating iron.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve, and how is it tested?
faqs.a: The 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve with its 316 stainless steel body is rated 10,000 psi working pressure (10K class). The listing states shell testing at 1.5 times working pressure; that shell test is a proof test and never a working pressure. Match every component in the line to this rating.

faqs.q: What materials is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve made from?
faqs.a: The 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve has a 316 stainless steel body; the trim is 316SS stem + 17-4PH spindle and the seals are Graphite + Inconel braided packing (sour). Body, trim and seals are listed to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 with material class EE. Stem, spindle and packing complete the pressure boundary.

faqs.q: Is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve suitable for sour (H2S) service, and which standard does it meet?
faqs.a: Yes. The 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve with its 316 stainless steel body is listed to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 with material class EE. Mill test reports to EN 10204 3.1 or 3.2 and the hydrostatic test certificate are supplied with the order, per the listing. Send the H2S, CO2 and chloride data and we confirm the fit.

faqs.q: What does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve connect to?
faqs.a: The process side is 1/2 in NPT Female (process) and the instrument side is 1/2 in NPT Female (instrument), so it sits between the process tap and the transmitter or gauge. See the [instrumentation valves shelf](/c/oilfield-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve operated and maintained?
faqs.a: On the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve, each of the three handles is independent, so close the two block valves, then open the bleed to vent the instrument side. The rising-stem T-bar handle is standard, a knurled knob is available for compact panels, and a lockable handle is available for LOTO. Read the [needle, globe and instrumentation valve guide](/blog/needle-globe-and-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve compare with a needle valve?
faqs.a: The 1/2 in 10,000 psi double block and bleed valve has two block valves and a bleed in one assembly so a gauge or transmitter can be isolated and vented safely, while a single needle valve only isolates once. See the [Gauge Isolation Valve, 1/2 in, 10,000 psi](/p/gauge-isolation-valve-single-block-1-2-in-npt-1-2-in-npt-10-000-psi-standard-service).

Mill test reports to EN 10204 3.1 or 3.2 and the hydrostatic test certificate are supplied with the order, per the listing. Send the H2S, CO2 and chloride data and we confirm the fit.

faqs.q: What does the 1/4 in 15,000 psi needle valve connect to?
faqs.a: It connects to instrument tubing and process taps through 1/4 in NPT Female on the inlet and 1/4 in NPT Female on the outlet, usually with NPT fittings of the same pressure rating. See the [instrumentation valves shelf](/c/oilfield-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How is the 1/4 in 15,000 psi needle valve operated and maintained?
faqs.a: On the 1/4 in 15,000 psi needle valve, the rising stem drives a tapered point into a precision orifice, so the flow is set finely over several turns. Close it fully for bubble-tight shut-off, and open it slowly to avoid pressure shock on instruments. Read the [needle, globe and instrumentation valve guide](/blog/needle-globe-and-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How does the 1/4 in 15,000 psi needle valve compare with a double block and bleed valve?
faqs.a: The 1/4 in 15,000 psi needle valve is a single stem valve for throttling and isolation, while a double block and bleed valve combines two block valves and a bleed in one assembly for positive isolation. See the [Double Block and Bleed (DBB) Needle Valve, 1/2 in, 10,000 psi](/p/double-block-and-bleed-dbb-needle-valve-three-handle-1-2-in-npt-10-000-psi-sour-service).

faqs.q: What is a 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve used for?
faqs.a: A 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve (10K, sour service) is a small-bore vent valve that opens to atmosphere or a closed bleed system to depressurise downstream instrumentation. Vent / drain leg for double-block-and-bleed instrumentation manifolds.

faqs.q: What does NPT female mean on the 1/2 in 10,000 psi valve ends (Bleed Valve, 1/2 in NPT, 10,000 psi, Sour Service, 316SS Body)?
faqs.a: The listing gives 1/2 in NPT Female on the inlet and 1/2 in NPT Female (vent) on the outlet; NPT is the tapered pipe thread and female means the thread is cut inside the valve body. Seal with thread sealant and confirm the thread rating with the mating fitting.

faqs.q: What end connections does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve have?
faqs.a: On the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve (sour service) the inlet is 1/2 in NPT Female and the outlet is 1/2 in NPT Female (vent). NPT ends make up with thread sealant such as PTFE tape or anaerobic sealant, and the threaded joint, not the valve, may limit the pressure of the assembly.

faqs.q: Should I choose the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve or the 1/2 in 10,000 psi version?
faqs.a: Choose by line size, pressure and service. This listing is 1/2 in at 10,000 psi (sour service); the [Double Block and Bleed (DBB) Needle Valve](/p/double-block-and-bleed-dbb-needle-valve-three-handle-1-2-in-npt-10-000-psi-sour-service) is rated 10,000 psi with 1/2 in NPT Female (process) on the inlet. Match pressure class and end connection of the mating iron.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve, and how is it tested?
faqs.a: The 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve with its 316 stainless steel body is rated 10,000 psi working pressure (10K class). The listing states shell testing at 1.5 times working pressure; that shell test is a proof test and never a working pressure. Match every component in the line to this rating.

faqs.q: What materials is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve made from?
faqs.a: The 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve has a 316 stainless steel body; the trim is 316SS stem + 17-4PH spindle and the seals are Graphite + Inconel braided packing (sour). Body, trim and seals are listed to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 with material class EE. Stem, spindle and packing complete the pressure boundary.

faqs.q: Is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve suitable for sour (H2S) service, and which standard does it meet?
faqs.a: Yes. The 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve with its 316 stainless steel body is listed to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 with material class EE. Mill test reports to EN 10204 3.1 or 3.2 and the hydrostatic test certificate are supplied with the order, per the listing. Send the H2S, CO2 and chloride data and we confirm the fit.

faqs.q: What does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve vent to?
faqs.a: The outlet is 1/2 in NPT Female (vent), which can be piped to atmosphere or a closed bleed system. See the [instrumentation valves shelf](/c/oilfield-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How is the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve operated and maintained?
faqs.a: On the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve, it opens to atmosphere or a closed bleed system to depressurise the instrument side after the blocks are closed. Vent to a safe location, particularly in sour service. Read the [needle, globe and instrumentation valve guide](/blog/needle-globe-and-instrumentation-valves).

faqs.q: How does the 1/2 in 10,000 psi bleed valve compare with a needle valve?
